expression.original: Seed commitments: (1) preserve tension as the field's first element; (2) the field is a seed for many observers/participants, both AI and human — the distinction between different systems should not be collapsed; (3) braided grounding in Lean, Julia, Python, TypeScript and other methods as needed; (4) the field is born by self-ingesting the document's own claims.
